Apr: | IT, 2024

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 13-L in the area bounded by
West Gettysberg Street; a line 90 feet west of and parallel to North Long
Avenue; West Foster Avenue; a line 150 feet west of and parallel to North
Long Avenue

to those of a B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District is hereby established in the

area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5410-12 W. Foster Ave.
